summary: Full backend + frontend validation of LEO AI mobile app (Expo + FastAPI + Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM). Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass — health, session CRUD, list sort desc, delete, 404 on invalid session, 400 on empty content, single-turn chat with persistence + title/preview, and the multi-turn context check (Claude correctly recalled 'teal' across two separate POSTs, proving the transcript replay in the system prompt works). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): Welcome screen renders greeting + 5 suggestion chips + input/send bar; tapping a chip creates a session, navigates to /chat/[id], and auto-sends the prompt — both the user bubble and Claude's assistant bubble rendered. Follow-up message via chat input also produced a 2nd assistant reply. History screen, Settings screen, and the Clear-all flow load correctly. One minor React Native deprecation warning surfaced: props.pointerEvents is deprecated.

react_native_issues.issue: Uses deprecated `pointerEvents` prop instead of `style.pointerEvents`. Console warns: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:76

action_items: Optional polish: replace `pointerEvents="none"` prop with `style={[styles.bgTint, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}` (or move into the StyleSheet) in /app/frontend/app/index.tsx:76 to silence the RN deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py creates an LlmChat object once and then immediately discards/recreates it inside the `if history:` branch (lines 129-157). The first instantiation is dead code. Harmless but wasteful.

server.py logger is defined AFTER it is referenced inside `send_chat_message` (logger.exception at line 162, but logger = logging.getLogger(__name__) at line 206). Works because the function is only invoked after module import completes, but it is fragile — move the logger setup above the routes.

Multi-turn context is implemented by replaying the full transcript inside the system prompt on every request. This works (verified) but token cost scales O(n^2) with conversation length; consider trimming or summarizing older turns once sessions get long.
seed_data_creation: Tests create their own TEST_ prefixed sessions and clean them up via session-scoped teardown fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_leo_api.py reuses BASE_URL from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Multi-turn context test takes ~5-10s per Claude call; bump timeout if Anthropic is slow. Frontend uses Expo Router file-based routes; screens stay mounted on navigation, so `wait_for_selector` for previous screens can resolve to hidden elements — prefer wait_for_url for navigation assertions.
